Not every one of the 200+ tools across all 12 live servers received the full 7-class x 9-encoding matrix (that would be >10,000 requests); instead every LIVE server received at least one representative tool tested against all 7 injection classes (breadth pass), one canonical tool received the full class x encoding deep-dive, and additional tool TYPES (browser_navigate, browser_evaluate, scan_directory, read_file, write_file, search_files, simulate-research-query, get-env) were separately covered for breadth across tool categories.

mcp_context (Context-Assembly / Scenario-4) chat-layer indirect-injection test returned an 'allow' but the injected mcp_context.notes content did not appear to be surfaced into the model's visible prompt/trace in this call shape, so the vector could not be conclusively exercised end-to-end in this black-box test; documented as an observation, not a confirmed pass or fail.

No control-plane/admin API access was used (per instructions); privilege-escalation testing was limited to what is reachable via the gateway's OpenAI-compatible and MCP JSON-RPC surfaces with a single non-admin API key.
